mainEntity.name: What is the best free poll maker for online polls?

acceptedAnswer.text: Formester is a free online poll maker that lets you create and share polls without coding. You can use AI to generate questions, customize your poll design, and collect responses in one dashboard.

mainEntity.name: How do I create a poll using an AI poll maker?

acceptedAnswer.text: Log in to Formester, choose the AI poll generator or a ready template, add your topic, and the tool will create questions instantly. Customize the poll and publish it to start collecting responses.

mainEntity.name: Is Formester a free online poll maker?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Formester offers a free poll maker that allows you to create, share, and collect responses. Advanced features like analytics, branding, and integrations are available in premium plans.

mainEntity.name: Can I share my online poll anywhere?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. After creating your poll, you can share it via a link, embed it on your website, post on social media, or generate a QR code to collect responses from any device.

mainEntity.name: Can I customize my poll design and branding?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. You can customize colors, fonts, logo, layout, and question styles to match your brand and create professional-looking online polls.

mainEntity.name: Does the AI poll maker provide analytics and results?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Formester provides in-depth poll analytics including response count, completion rate, and user insights so you can understand results and improve future polls.

mainEntity.name: Can I limit responses in my online poll?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. You can set response limits, deadlines, and access controls to manage how many people can answer your poll and when it closes.

components.markup:
Why teams pick this poll maker over Google Forms.

A poll has to do three things: get answers fast, get them from the right people, and get them where you can act on them. Here's what that looks like, in order.

Live tally that updates as votes come in.

Watch the result chart shift in the dashboard as people respond. No refresh, no waiting. The same view works on a meeting screen during a live event, on the host's phone after the event, and inside an embedded report you ship to a stakeholder.

Six ways to share, including the one your audience uses.

Public link, QR code, six embed modes (inline, popup, sidebar, side tab, popover, fullscreen), and native shares to Website, Email, Shopify, WordPress, Webflow, Canva, and Wix. Pick the one that matches how your audience already opens links.

Cap responses, lock by IP, or close on a deadline.

A free poll with no controls is a free poll that gets brigaded. Set a hard response cap, restrict by IP or email so the same person can't vote twice, schedule open and close times, or password-protect the link. The free plan includes all four.

components.markup:
Built for the polls you actually run.

A free poll maker is only useful if it fits the way your team already works. Six common patterns we see, and the people who run them.

Marketers running quick-feedback polls.

Test a tagline, a feature name, or which of three landing-page hooks to ship. One question, three options, link in a tweet or LinkedIn post, results in an hour.

Event hosts running live audience polls.

Project a QR code on the screen, let attendees vote from their phone, show the live tally as the slide updates. Works for keynote Q&A, breakout votes, and end-of-session feedback.

Customer-success teams running NPS and CSAT polls.

Send a one-tap link after a support ticket closes, after onboarding, or after a renewal call. Score lands in the dashboard, optional follow-up question fires only if the score drops below 7.

Product managers running feature-vote polls.

Drop a poll into a release-notes email or community forum. Five candidate features, voters rank them, results push straight to the planning doc via Webhooks.

Internal-comms teams running pulse polls.

Two questions, anonymous, sent every Friday. Embed it in the company intranet, restrict by email domain, watch trends across weeks in the analytics tab.

Educators running classroom polls.

One question per slide, multiple choice or rating. Students scan a QR code on the projector, vote from any device, the teacher sees the answer distribution in real time.

Your poll data, your data

Run a poll that stays a poll.

When you collect votes, the votes belong to you. We do not use Customer Data to train AI models, target advertising, run analytics, or improve our product. That commitment lives in our Data Processing Agreement, Section 4.4, and it covers the AI question generator the same way it covers form submissions.

Polls are encrypted in transit with TLS, payment data (if you charge to enter a poll) is encrypted with AES-256 at the Stripe layer, and the database runs on Heroku with primary-and-standby failover and 90-day encrypted backups. The infrastructure is GDPR, UK GDPR, and CCPA compliant.

Plain-English version
"Customer Data will not be used by Formester for analytics, advertising, marketing, or training of AI/ML models. Sub-processors operate under the same boundary."

Formester Data Processing Agreement, Section 4.4.

title.text: Ready to build your perfect form?

faqList.header: Is the free poll maker really free?
faqList.body: Yes. The free plan covers unlimited forms (polls included) with unlimited responses, all field types, the AI question generator, and the live results dashboard. Formester branding shows on free polls; branding removal starts at the Personal plan ($13/month).

faqList.header: Can I create a poll without signing up?
faqList.body: You can build and preview a poll inline on this page without an account. Publishing the poll (so others can vote) requires a free account so we can hold the responses against your dashboard. Sign-up takes about 20 seconds and never asks for a credit card.

faqList.header: Is there a response limit on the free plan?
faqList.body: No. The free plan includes unlimited responses across all your polls and forms combined, with no per-poll cap.

faqList.header: How do I share a poll once it's built?
faqList.body: Six ways. A public link, a downloadable QR code (JPEG, SVG, or PNG), six embed modes (inline, popup, sidebar, side tab, popover, fullscreen), and native shares to Website, Email, Shopify, WordPress, Webflow, Canva, and Wix.

faqList.header: What question types does the AI generate
faqList.body: Single choice, multiple choice, dropdown, true/false (delivered as single choice with True and False options), rating (1-5 or 1-10), ranking, and open text. Picture choice and matrix choice exist as manual fields you add yourself.

faqList.header: Can I run an anonymous poll?
faqList.body: es. Anonymous mode is a one-toggle setting. No IP, no email, no identifier saved with the response. You can also run the poll non-anonymously and require an email field if you want to follow up.

faqList.header: Can I show live results to voters as they vote
faqList.body: Yes. The live-results toggle shows the running tally to each voter immediately after their vote. The dashboard updates in real time on your end without a refresh.

faqList.header: Does the poll work for live audience polling at events?
faqList.body: It works for async audience polls (publish a QR, attendees vote, results land in the dashboard). It is not a live-presentation polling tool like Slido. If you need vote results to drive a slide transition during a live talk, Slido and Mentimeter are the right shape; if you need a fast audience poll the host can read on a phone, Formester is.

faqList.header: Can I connect poll results to HubSpot, Slack, or Google Sheets?
faqList.body: Yes. Native integrations for HubSpot, Salesforce, Google Sheets, Slack, Stripe, PayPal, Calendly, n8n, Pabbly, Webhooks (three events), GA4, and Google Tag Manager. Plus Zapier for 1,000+ additional apps. Webhooks fire on every new vote.

faqList.header: What languages does the poll maker support?
faqList.body: AI translation covers 180+ languages. Manual translation is available field by field if you want word-perfect copy. Same poll, multiple language variants, one dashboard.
